---
name: Research or integration opportunity
about: Suggest a useful domain, contribute a fixture, or challenge a research route
---

## The job you want to do
Which tool/workflow do you use, and what is difficult today?

## Relevant question or capability
Pipeline ID or link if known. A new domain or a counterexample is welcome.

## Smallest useful test
Input, baseline, desired output and a result that would disprove the idea.
Include a command/trace if available; do not upload private data or secrets.

## Constraints and contribution
Target/language, timing or resource limits, license/permission for inputs, and what you can help test.

## Evidence and uncertainty
What have you actually tried? What is inferred or unknown? Disclose AI assistance if used.
